mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(totalAmt), 0) FROM expense WHERE expenseStatus = 'posted'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expense WHERE expenseStatus = 'draft' AND expenseDt BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAY(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY) -- 이번 달 1일 AND LAST_DAY(CURDATE()) -- 이번 달 말일

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(x.y, '%Y-%m') AS ym, IFNULL(SUM(r.totalAmt), 0) AS total FROM ( /* 최근 12개월의 월 첫날 목록 */ SELECT DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB( DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAY(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY), INTERVAL n.n MONTH ), '%Y-%m-01' ) AS y FROM (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11) n) x LEFT JOIN revenue r ON r.revenueDt >= x.y AND r.revenueDt < DATE_ADD(x.y, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY x.y ORDER BY x.y
